steps.description:
Rolling Animation

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Created a variable named dice and assign it a random number from 1 to 6

2. Display the dice variable value on the LCD Screen for 0.3 seconds

3. Repeat step 1 to 2 ten times

4. Display the dice variable value for 2 seconds

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can do the following when a button is pressed and then released:
1. Display the text "Press to roll the dice" until Button is pressed and then released

2. When the Button is pressed and then released, continue Steps 3 to 6

3. Created a variable named dice and assign it a random number from 1 to 6

4. Display the dice variable value on the LCD Screen for 0.3 seconds

5. Repeat step 3 to 4 ten times

6. Display the dice variable value for 2 seconds

7. Repeat steps 1 to 6

The program can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked

Show that your robot can do the following when a button is pressed and then released:
1. Display the text "Press to roll the dices" until Button is pressed and then released

2. When the Button is pressed and then released, continue Steps 3 to 8

3. Created a variable named dice1 and assign it a random number from 1 to 6

4. Created a variable named dice2 and assign it a random number from 1 to 6

5. Display the dice1 variable value on the left side of the LCD Screen

6. Display the dice2 variable value on the right side of the LCD Screen

7. Display steps 5 and 6 for 0.3 seconds

7. Repeat steps 3 to 4 ten times

8. Display the dice1 variable value on the left side and dice2 variable value on the right side of the LCD screen for 1 second

The program can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked

Show that your robot can do the following when a button is pressed and then released:
1. Display the text "Press to roll the dice" until Button is pressed and then released

2. When the Button is pressed and then released, continue Steps 3 to 8

3. Created a variable named dice1 and assign it a random number from 1 to 6

4. Created a variable named dice2 and assign it a random number from 1 to 6

5. Display the dice1 variable value on the left side of the LCD Screen

6. Display the dice2 variable value on the right side of the LCD Screen

7. Display steps 5 and 6 for 0.3 seconds

7. Repeat steps 3 to 4 ten times

8. Display the dice1 variable value on the left side and dice2 variable value on the right side of the LCD screen for 1 second

9. Depending on two numerical values of the dice, display the larger number on the LCD screen for 2 seconds with the following format:

Move # Steps

Example 1:
If two dices rolled 5 and 6, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 6 Steps

Example 2:
If two dices rolled 3 and 1, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 3 Steps

10. If the value of the two dice is the same, the duration would be the sum of both numerical values of the dice.

Example 1:
If the two dices rolled 5 and 5, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 10 steps

Example 2:
If the two dices rolled 3 and 3, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 6 steps

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.
